optionalfeature.name: Fake Sight
entries: You can see in dim light and darkness as if it were brighter, out to a suspiciously specific radius.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Weapon Focus
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with weapons that aren't real.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Empowered Bolt
entries: When you cast Fake Bolt, add your Charisma modifier to the pretend damage it deals on a hit.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Arcane Surge
entries: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 Fake Sorcery Point to make it feel more dramatic. This has no mechanical effect.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Deep Cut
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one Fake Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Trip Attack
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one Fake Superiority Die to try to knock it down.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Guard Stance
entries: While you are wielding a shield that isn't real, your imaginary AC increases by 1.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Elemental Burst
entries: You spend 2 ki points to unleash a burst of imaginary elemental energy in a 15-foot cone.

optionalfeature.name: Fake Blade Bond
entries: You can telepathically speak to your fake familiar and perceive through its senses while it's on the same plane of existence as you.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Fake Chain
entries: You learn a spell that lets you summon a fake familiar, distinct from the one summoned by a real find familiar spell.
